name: modules
help: Modules to run, comma separated. Available now - ci (CI health), flow (Team Flow, on schedule and manual runs), deps (dependency check on pull requests that change a lockfile), community (newcomers, first answers, stars and traffic, on schedule and manual runs), portal (the org catalog, run from the org's private portal repo)

name: token
help: Token that can read Actions and write the stackvitals-data branch

name: portal-token
help: Optional token from an org-owned read-only GitHub App, so Portal reads the org's private repos (without it, public repos only)

name: portal-org
help: The org Portal catalogs (default - the owner of the repo it runs in)

name: traffic-token
help: Optional token from your own GitHub App with Administration read, so Community keeps traffic past GitHub's 14 days (the built-in token can't read traffic)

name: days
help: Days of history to fill in on the first runs (GitHub keeps at most 90)

name: budget
help: Most API requests per run (the built-in token allows 1,000 an hour)

name: tests
help: Read test reports (JUnit XML or CTRF JSON) from your run artifacts to find single flaky tests

name: test-artifacts
help: Regex for the artifact names that hold test reports (empty = names with junit, test-results, ctrf...)

name: pr-comments
help: One comment on failed PR runs saying which failures are known flakes (needs pull-requests write)

name: rerun-flaky
help: Re-run failed jobs once when every failure is a known flake (needs actions write)

name: quarantine
help: Keep a list of flaky tests for the stackvitals ci quarantine command

name: preflight-comments
help: Team Flow - one note on new outside PRs that miss what merged PRs here usually include (needs pull-requests write)

name: deps-comments
help: Dependency check - one comment on same-repo PRs listing changed packages and their verdicts (needs pull-requests write)

name: issues
help: Keep one issue per flaky test or job, closed once fixed (needs issues write)

name: mention-owners
help: @-mention a flaky test's code owners in the issues StackVitals opens (off: owners are named without a notification)

name: webhook
help: Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams (Workflows) or any JSON webhook URL (pass a secret) to hear when something newly turns flaky and when a delivery number crosses its threshold

name: events-url
help: An HTTP endpoint (pass a secret) that gets findings as CloudEvents, CDEvents' custom form, such as a CDviz collector, Argo Events or n8n

name: events-token
help: A token (pass a secret) with write access to the contents of the repo named in [events] dispatch_repo, which then gets each finding as a repository_dispatch

name: team-webhooks
help: One "@org/team = https://..." line per team (pass a secret); a team's newly flaky tests go to its own chat, the rest to webhook

name: jira-email
help: The Jira Cloud account's email (pass a secret); with jira-token and [connectors.jira] url, issues, sprints and incidents are read

name: jira-token
help: A Jira Cloud API token for that account (pass a secret; it expires within a year, so set key_expires to be warned)

name: linear-token
help: A Linear personal API key (pass a secret); issues and cycles of the teams under [connectors.linear] are read

name: pagerduty-token
help: A PagerDuty REST API key, read-only (pass a secret); its incidents then count in DORA instead of labels, reverts and hotfixes

name: incident-io-token
help: An incident.io API key with read access (pass a secret); its incidents then count in DORA instead of labels, reverts and hotfixes

name: sonar-token
help: A SonarQube or SonarCloud token (pass a secret), only for a private project or your own server; public SonarCloud projects need none

name: copilot-token
help: A token that can read the org's Copilot usage reports (an org App with "Organization Copilot metrics" read, or a fine-grained token); kept day by day

name: anthropic-admin-key
help: An Anthropic Admin API key (sk-ant-admin..., pass a secret); the organisation's daily Claude API cost is set beside AI-involved pull requests

name: openai-admin-key
help: An OpenAI admin key (pass a secret); the organisation's daily API cost is set beside AI-involved pull requests

name: cursor-admin-key
help: A Cursor admin API key (pass a secret); the team's billing-cycle spend and daily agent use are set beside AI-involved pull requests

name: slack-token
help: A Slack bot token (channels:history) that reads the support channels under [connectors.slack]; only times and flags are kept

name: discord-token
help: A Discord bot token (View Channel, Read Message History) that reads the support channels under [connectors.discord]; only times and flags are kept

name: imports-json
help: Path to the list of packages your code imports (`stackvitals deps imports --out imports.json` in an earlier step, after checkout) for Python, JavaScript and Rust repos; known vulnerabilities then say whether your code imports the package (an import, not a call path)

name: govulncheck-json
help: Path to govulncheck's JSON output (`govulncheck -format json ./... > govulncheck.json` in an earlier step) for Go repos; the supply page then says which advisories the code really calls

name: triage-key
help: A model API key (pass a secret, e.g. a free Gemini key from Google AI Studio) for [ci.triage]; up to 3 undecided failures per run get a model's view beside the verdict

name: label-stuck
help: Label pull requests whose asked-for review has not started after 3 days ("stackvitals: waiting for review"), and take the label off once one has (needs pull-requests or issues write)

name: retention-days
help: Days of pull request, issue and Portal history kept in the data branch

name: ci-retention-days
help: Days of CI run and test history kept in the data branch

name: size-cap-mb
help: Most history kept in the data branch, in MB; the oldest days go first

name: squash-history
help: Every 1,000 commits, rewrite the data branch to one commit (files unchanged; the branch is force-pushed)

name: pages
help: "branch" (default): GitHub Pages serves the stackvitals-data branch. "deploy": this job publishes the monitor itself (Pages source "GitHub Actions"; the job needs pages and id-token write and the github-pages environment), for busy repos past 10 Pages builds an hour. "artifact": no Pages; each run that changed the app uploads it as a workflow artifact (kept 7 days, or less if your org sets a shorter limit) to download and open locally, for private repos; anyone who can read the repo can download it

name: storage
help: Where history is kept: "git" (default, the stackvitals-data branch) or an S3-compatible bucket as s3://bucket/prefix (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO: the service must support replace-only-if-unchanged writes, If-Match), for very busy repos and big orgs. Switching starts a fresh history (the branch is not copied). With a bucket, publish the app with pages "deploy" or "artifact"; the tools that read the stackvitals-data branch (stackvitals ui and sql, Explore, the MCP server, the Portal org view, quarantine in your CI) do not read a bucket yet

name: s3-endpoint
help: The bucket service's endpoint, like https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com or https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com

name: s3-region
help: The bucket's region ("auto" for R2)

name: s3-key-id
help: An access key id that can read, write, delete and list that prefix (pass a secret)

name: s3-secret
help: Its secret (pass a secret)
